hypothesis: Relative momentum among BTC, ETH and SOL can persist for several days, allowing a weekly strongest-asset position or a strongest-minus-weakest spread with less dependence on absolute crypto direction.
inspiration_not_evidence: Classic cross-sectional momentum; schedule, grid, costs and all evidence are newly preregistered.

data_contract.input: independently checksummed Binance spot M1 aggregated to strict UTC D1
data_contract.decision_time: Monday 00:00 UTC using only prior completed D1 bars
data_contract.proxy_limitation: Negative evidence is terminal; positive evidence cannot promote until all three Ostium native parity gates pass

cost_model.rollover_conservatism: Charge carry on every leg; do not assume long/short offset.

execution_contract.ranking: trailing close-to-close return ending on Sunday close
execution_contract.short_leg: lowest ranked asset only in hedged mode
execution_contract.risk_weighting: equal stop-risk per active leg using prior ATR
execution_contract.exit: gap-adverse ATR stop per leg or close after 1/3/7/14 days
execution_contract.overlap: if prior portfolio remains open, skip the new Monday signal

stability.representative: graph medoid per mode without performance metrics

sqcli_policy: No SQCLI until stable development, validation, OOS, small-account economics and three native parity gates pass.
